candidates.change_summary: Change blockAssertion from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change arbitrateViaEscalationManager from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change discardOracle from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change validateDisputers from false to true in the returned AssertionPolicy struct.
Change the return value from true to false
Return a fixed non-zero value instead of the default zero, which changes the return value for any args.
Return a negative value so that any caller sees a different price than the default zero.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so requestPrice can be called by anyone, changing when PriceRequestAdded is emitted.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so anyone can call assertionResolvedCallback.
Change the modifier check to always revert, making assertionResolvedCallback uncallable.
Remove the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionDisputedCallback so it can be called by anyone, changing its observable behavior (the function will no longer revert for non-OA callers).
Change the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier to always revert, preventing assertionDisputedCallback from ever completing successfully.

Change the modifier check to require msg.sender != address(optimisticAsserter), reversing the access control so the optimistic asserter is blocked and everyone else can call assertionDisputedCallback.
